about: M08 S3: every conditional branch of the nvcc-built kernels, read by hand in the saved cuobjdump listing (runs/<M08_sass>/sass_<file>.txt). 'setter' is the instruction that writes the predicate; 'source' is the construct in kernels/*.cu; 'depends_on' is what the predicate is computed from. sass_check.py labels all of them DATA because its trace is flow-insensitive: a register that once held a loaded value (R25, R29) is later reused as a loop counter. vcloak.bench.report_oblivious refuses to build if a branch of the listing has no entry here or if the instruction at that address has changed.

branches.setter: 0040 ISETP.GE.U32.AND P0, PT, R0, c[0x0][0x188], PT
branches.depends_on: thread id (blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x) and the public parameter npairs

branches.setter: 0040 ISETP.GE.U32.AND P0, PT, R3, c[0x0][0x188], PT
branches.depends_on: block id, block size and the public parameter n

branches.setter: 01e0 ISETP.NE.AND P0, PT, RZ, c[0x0][0x184], PT
branches.source: for (u32 j = j_start; j > 0; ...) loop entry

branches.setter: 0580 ISETP.NE.AND P0, PT, R25, RZ, PT
branches.depends_on: j: R25 is set from j_start at 02a0 and shifted right by one at 0310

branches.setter: 0040 ISETP.GE.U32.AND P0, PT, R3, c[0x0][0x180], PT
branches.depends_on: block id, block size and the public parameter n

branches.setter: 0210 ISETP.NE.AND P0, PT, RZ, UR4, PT
branches.source: for (u32 k = 2; k <= 2 * T; ...) loop entry

branches.setter: 02d0 ISETP.NE.AND P0, PT, R29, RZ, PT
branches.source: for (u32 j = k >> 1; j > 0; ...) loop entry
branches.depends_on: k: R29 is the constant 2 at 02c0 and is doubled at 0670

branches.setter: 05d0 ISETP.NE.AND P0, PT, R34, RZ, PT
branches.depends_on: j: R34 is k >> 1 at 02f0 and is shifted right by one at 0360

branches.setter: 0680 ISETP.GT.U32.AND P0, PT, R29, UR4, PT
branches.source: for (...; k <= 2 * T; k <<= 1) back edge

branches.setter: 0040 ISETP.GE.U32.AND P0, PT, R2, c[0x0][0x170], PT
branches.depends_on: thread id and the public parameter n

branches.source: the 10 double rounds of chacha_block (block 0, one-time key)
branches.depends_on: round counter: R3 is zero at 01e0, plus one at 02b0, compared with the constant 10

branches.source: the 10 double rounds of chacha_block (block 1, keystream)
branches.depends_on: round counter: R31 is zero at 0990, plus one at 09c0, compared with the constant 10

branches.setter: 0040 ISETP.GE.U32.AND P0, PT, R0, c[0x0][0x188], PT
branches.depends_on: thread id and the public parameter nblocks
round counter: R24 is zero at 00f0, plus one at 0210, compared with the constant 10

branches.setter: 0040 ISETP.GE.U32.AND P0, PT, R5, c[0x0][0x17c], PT
branches.depends_on: thread id and the public parameter nblocks
round counter: R33 is zero at 0140, plus one at 0260, compared with the constant 10
